id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

activeTab.description:
Tab id indicating which tab to be shown. This is the highlighted item in the component.
Each page has to set its active tab according to the page that is being shown.

tabs.description: List of tabs to show to the right of the page title.

HTMLTitle.description:
The title text for broswer tab.
{@link UiSdlPageTab} also has HTMLTitle to configure text
for individual tab, therefore that field will take precedence when both exist.

titleInfoTooltip.description: The page description rendered as a tooltip upon hover.

actionGroup.description: The action group to show to the right.

fixedPosition.description: Whether the page title position will be fixed.

autoFill.description: Used for global filter to automatically apply the first available selection of the input field as the default filter.

title: A UI component type for the page title.
name: UiSdlPageTitle
